# lumos_app_entitlement_app_store_catalog (Data Source)

AppEntitlementAppStoreCatalog DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lumos_app_entitlement_app_store_catalog" "my_appentitlementappstorecatalog" {
  app_uuid         = "...my_app_uuid..."
  page_size        = 100
  page_token       = "...my_page_token..."
  target_user_uuid = "...my_target_user_uuid..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_uuid` (String)

### Optional

- `page_size` (Number) Maximum number of items to return per page. Values above 1000 are clamped to 1000 rather than rejected.
- `page_token` (String) Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_page_token`. Omit to fetch the first page. Treat as opaque: do not decode, construct, or interpret it.
- `target_user_uuid` (String) UUID of the user whose entitlement AppStore catalog to view. Defaults to the caller. Viewing another user's catalog requires READ_APP_STORE_ITEMS on this app.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) Entitlements returned in this page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `next_page_token` (String) Token for the next page, or null when this is the last page. An absent token is the only end-of-results signal. A page holding fewer than `page_size` items does not mean the results are exhausted. Treat the value as opaque: do not decode, construct, or interpret it.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Optional long-form description of the entitlement.
- `id` (String) The ID of this entitlement.
- `label` (String) Human-readable label for the entitlement (e.g. a role or permission name).
- `source` (String)
- `time_based_access` (Attributes List) This entitlement's effective time-based access options -- its own, if overridden, otherwise inherited from the app or domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--time_based_access))

<a id="nestedatt--items--time_based_access"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.time_based_access`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) Display label for this time-based access option.
- `value_seconds` (Number) Duration in seconds. Null indicates a permanent (unlimited) access option.
